correctness.rationale: Construct transitive-face simplices with canonical source-to-sink order, f=(11,55,110,55), chain matrices satisfying d1*d2=d2*d3=0. Independent Python/SymPy enumeration of all C(11,5)=462 supports finds precisely 55 with beta_2(F2)=1 and affine orbit of W0={0,1,2,3,7}; W0 six triangles form triangular-bipyramid sphere plus extra edge, with no tetrahedra. d1 rank10, d2 rank45, d3 rank55; exact Smith d3 factors 1^54 and 2 => H2 free rank 65-55=10 with Z/2. Construct orientation cycles of 55 spheres, augment d3: exact Smith has precisely 65 nonzero factors all units, establishing saturation of rank65 primitive ker d2. Tetrahedral sum d3 has 110 coefficients ±2 (55 each); half is integral cycle with 2z boundary, and d3 rationally injective forces z not boundary. Affine action permutes source-to-sink tetrahedra, so z fixed. All claims independently replayed with exact integer operations, not inferred from logs.
